5.0.SP2.description: Code to represent the type of instrument attribute

values.1: Flat (securities pay interest on a current basis but are traded without interest)
values.3: Interest bearing (for Euro commercial paper when not issued at discount)
values.8: Coupon period (if not semi-annual). Supply redemption date in the InstrAttribValue <872> field.
values.13: Escrowed to redemption date - callable. Supply redemption date in the InstrAttribValue <872> field
values.20: Original issue discount price. Supply price in the InstrAttribValue <872> field
values.22: Callable without notice by mail to holder unless registered
values.24: Trade type eligibility details for security.
values.99: Text. Supply the text of the attribute or disclaimer in the InstrAttribValue <872> field.
